title: Implement independent Fleet Security Protocols clauses (Legacy Lane A)

cards.title: Fleet Security Protocols
issues: Power clause differs from PC: PC says characters at related starship/vehicle sites cumulatively add 2 to YOUR TOTAL POWER during battle where you have a starship or vehicle; code gives each participating vessel +2 power per character.
Missing: those characters may be forfeited to reduce battle damage or attrition.
Missing: when a starship/vehicle site leaves table, place it and all cards there in owner's Used Pile.
setGameText rewritten; does not match PC.

review.fix_instructions: Use PC gametext; replace the PowerModifier with a total-power modifier (+2 per your character at related starship/vehicle sites of your starships/vehicles in the battle); allow those characters to be forfeited to battle damage/attrition; add the site-leaves-table Used Pile rule; tests.
review.notes: Once-per-turn non-unique ship/vehicle site download fine.

pc_front.gametext: Deploy on table. Once per turn, may deploy a non-unique starship (or vehicle) site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle where you have a starship or vehicle, characters at related starship (or vehicle) sites cumulatively add 2 to your total power and may be forfeited to reduce battle damage or attrition. When a starship (or vehicle) site leaves table, place it and all cards there in owner's Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)
pc_front.lore: Since the debacle at Yavin, the Emperor places a premium on the security of his costly war machine.
pc_front.title: •Fleet Security Protocols

title: Implement independent Carnor Jax and Royal Escort clauses (Legacy Lane A)

cards.title: Carnor Jax, Royal Guard
issues: Missing: Imperials may not have deploy costs increased (or be excluded from battle) by opponent here.
Missing: when using a Force Pike, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one (may take the other into hand).

cards.title: Royal Escort (V)
issues: Missing: "'Emperor' on Royal Guards may be treated as 'Sidious'."
Cosmetic: setGameText uses '[download]' wording instead of PC 'deploy ... from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'.

review.fix_instructions: Jax: add opponent-sourced deploy-cost-increase immunity and may-not-be-excluded-from-battle for Imperials here; add the two-weapon-destiny choice when firing a Force Pike (precedent Card1117_019). Escort: implement Emperor->Sidious substitution on Royal Guards (ModifyGameTextModifier pattern). Tests for each.
review.notes: Jax only has stats and immunity <3. Escort's deploy restriction, SE Coruscant icon, attrition and Force Pike download fine.

pc_front.gametext: Imperials may not have their deploy costs increased (or be excluded from battle) by opponent here. When using a Force Pike, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one (may take the other into hand). Immune to attrition < 3.
pc_front.title: •Carnor Jax, Royal Guard

pc_front.gametext: Deploy on table unless your [Reflections 2] Objective on table. Unique (•) [Special Edition] Coruscant sites gain one [Light Side Force]. 'Emperor' on Royal Guards may be treated as 'Sidious.' Attrition against opponent is +1 for each battleground site occupied by two Royal Guards. May use 1 Force to deploy a Force Pike from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)
pc_front.lore: When away from the Imperial Palace on Coruscant, the Emperor is protected by legions of troops. Typically this force includes soldiers trained to fight in local environment.
pc_front.title: •Royal Escort (V)

title: Implement independent Command Station and Black 11 clauses (Legacy Lane A)

cards.title: Star Destroyer: Command Station
issues: Missing: while you control, related starship may move as a 'react' (MayMoveAsReactModifier exists).
setGameText says 'If you control' and '[download] Jir'; PC says 'While you control' and 'deploy Jir here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'.

cards.title: DS-61-11 In Black 11
issues: Missing: whenever you deploy a TIE simultaneously with a pilot character, your Force retrieval from Sienar Fleet Systems is +1.

review.fix_instructions: Station: add MayMoveAsReactModifier for the related starship under ControlsCondition; restore PC text. Black 11: add a modifier increasing Sienar Fleet Systems' retrieval by 1 when a TIE deploys simultaneously with a pilot (may need a small engine hook). Tests.
review.notes: Station power protection, Light attrition immunity, Devastator-gated Jir download fine. Black 11 stats/pilot/immunity fine.

pc_front.gametext: Dark: While you control, related starship may not have its power reduced and may move as a 'react.' Once per game, if Devastator on table, may deploy Jir here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: Unless you control, related starship is immune to attrition < 4 or adds 2 to immunity (if on Devastator and opponent controls this site, immune to attrition).
pc_front.title: •••Star Destroyer: Command Station

pc_front.gametext: Permanent pilot is •DS-61-11, who provides ability of 2. Whenever you deploy a TIE simultaneously with a pilot character, your Force retrieval from Sienar Fleet Systems is +1. Immune to attrition < 5.
pc_front.lore: Stationed aboard command ship Executor. Pilot known as 'Wampa' for icy precision in battle. Often serves as escort to Lord Vader's shuttle.
pc_front.title: •DS-61-11 In Black 11
